company_name: Energy Intelligent Equipment Wuxi Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in intelligent equipment for semiconductor packaging, a critical part of the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Energy Intelligent Equipment Wuxi Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures intelligent equipment specifically for the semiconductor packaging sector. Their offerings include a range of equipment series designed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of packaging processes, along with Automatic Optical Inspection solutions to ensure high-quality standards.
